updates.title: Hybrid Work Policy Update
updates.description: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Core in-office days are Tuesday and Thursday.
updates.previous_policy: Remote work subject to manager approval with no standard framework

updates.title: Mental Health Support Days
updates.description: Employees may take up to 3 additional mental health days per year without requiring medical documentation.
updates.previous_policy: No separate mental health day provision

updates.title: Enhanced Parental Leave
updates.description: Paternity/partner leave extended from 4 weeks to 8 weeks paid. Secondary caregiver leave added: 4 weeks paid.

updates.title: Learning & Development Budget Increase
updates.description: Education reimbursement increased from $5,000 to $7,500 per year. Now includes conferences and online subscriptions.
updates.previous_policy: $5,000 per year for approved courses only

updates.title: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Policy
updates.description: New comprehensive DEI policy including unconscious bias training (mandatory), ERG support, and inclusive language guidelines.

updates.title: Employee Data Privacy Notice Update
updates.description: Updated to comply with latest data protection regulations. Includes right to access, rectification, and deletion of employee personal data.
